title: Introduce 'ebb' staged-degradation governor and jitter-tolerant circuit holdoff hotpatch
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Hotfix: Add staged-degradation governor (ebb) to smooth tenant load shedding and fix rapid circuit flip during regional heartbeat jitter. No API changes.
description: Motivation: recent incidents showed abrupt tenant-level load shedding and rapid circuit flips when regional heartbeat jitter and short-lived control-plane blips coincide; this caused cascading retries and SLO violations. This PR introduces a staged-degradation governor (internal codename 'ebb') that ramps admission reductions gradually with a configurable decay and a jitter-tolerant circuit holdoff window. Goals: 1) reduce slamming tenants with sudden large shed percentages; 2) make circuits resilient to noisy heartbeats by increasing reopen hysteresis and adding a short probing backoff; 3) provide operable feature flags and telemetry to tune the behavior in production. Changes: implemented staged governor algorithm with tokenized tranche reductions and exponential decay; added a heartbeat-variance estimator and used it to adapt circuit reopen holdoff; wired new metrics and traces; added unit and integration tests; included a small ops runbook and observability docs. Checklist: [x] unit tests added; [x] integration tests against local simulator; [x] telemetry dashboards documented; [x] feature flag gated; [x] canary rollout plan included. Backwards compatibility: configuration keys are additive; default behavior preserves current shedding policy until feature flag/helm value is enabled. Rollout plan: enable feature for 5% of traffic in us-east for 30 minutes; watch latency_p50/p95 and token_per_request cost and slo_error_rate; expand to 25% then 100% per cadence in PR notes. Rollback: disable feature flag and roll back the helm value; emergency revert notes included in runbook. Additional context: linear tickets ENG-7821 and ENG-7903 cover the incident timeline and the design doc; SUP-2146 contains the customer impact reports. Implementation notes: careful about concurrent updates to tenant penalty ledger; used CAS updates to avoid races; KV cache pressure is unchanged but we added a telemetry-backed circuit snapshot to avoid noisy reopen storms. Operator notes: new metrics ebb.shed.percentage, ebb.decay.time_ms, circuit.holdoff.adaptive_ms, and telemetry tags region and tenant_cohort were added. CI: one integration test intermittently failed on the first run due to simulator timing; rerun passed. Impact analysis: expected to reduce abrupt token dropoffs and retry storms; may slightly increase average latency for shed requests as they are drained more gracefully. Monitoring: set alerts for >2x baseline slo_error_rate or > 20% unexpected decrease in throughput during canary. Contact: @aisha for follow-ups.
